# The findings the nilness port makes over whole trees that x/tools' nilness does not, each exactly as cohere-parity
# prints it, the path relative to the tree's root, with why on the comment lines above it. cohere-parity reads this
# file; a finding only the port makes that no line here records fails as an unexplained gain.

# The standard library (cohere-parity "$(go env GOROOT)/src" std). prev is only ever assigned nil, at nodes.go:624 and
# :628, so it is nil on every edge into the loop's comparison. staticcheck merges the same constant from every edge
# into that constant, where x/tools keeps a phi over the loop's back edge whose inputs are all nil and never folds it:
# the onlyEverNil class of differences.go. Confirmed on a reproduction of the loop beside the differences fixture: the
# port alone reports it, and with prev assigned a value that can be non-nil neither side does.
go/printer/nodes.go:613:13: impossible condition: nil != nil

# cmd (cohere-parity "$(go env GOROOT)/src" cmd/...). source is nil on the branch that compares it, being assigned only
# on the other, and the closure handed to LookupInit at obj9.go:436 captures it later. x/tools keeps a captured
# variable in memory for the whole function, its value unknown, where staticcheck lifts it up to the capture: the
# capturedLater class of differences.go. Confirmed on a reproduction of rewriteToUseTOC beside the differences
# fixture: the port alone reports it, and with the closure no longer capturing source both sides do.
cmd/internal/obj/ppc64/obj9.go:416:13: impossible condition: nil != nil
